test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 16 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. If there is no error, select 'No error'.**

In another words, most of us / are made by our elders or by our / peers, but leaders are self - directed.

options.text: peers, but leaders are self - directed.
In another words, most of us
are made by our elders or by our

solution:
The correct answer is: "**In another words, most of us**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The error in the sentence is related to the choice of words and the proper use of the idiom "in other words."
 
• The correct phrase is "**In other words**" instead of "**In another words**".
 
• "In other words" is a common idiom used to introduce a rephrasing or clarification of a previous statement.
 
• The word "another" is not needed in this context, and its use makes the sentence ungrammatical.
 
• "In another words" is not a standard or correct phrase in English. 

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**.

**Corrected sentence**: *In other words, most of us are made by our elders or by our peers, but leaders are self-directed.*
